text:
Ana (Product): Quick design review — sharing the latest Private/VPC setup wizard mock. Focus areas: conditional networking fields, more actionable preflight, clearer copy for CIDR/IPs, and small a11y fixes. Please chime in with priorities.
Michael (Design): Nice. Two immediate nits: rename 'External IP' -> 'Outbound IP(s)' for clarity, and move the 'Test connectivity' button inline next to the IP input so users can validate fast. Also thinking the preflight card should show simple green/red rows, not a giant modal. :sparkles: 
Srini (Eng): From infra POV — inline tests are fine but they must be rate-limited and non-blocking for the rest of the form. Prefer the test to run as a background check and surface status badges (pending/pass/fail) so users can continue. Do not open a modal for failures; let them fix inline.
Jia (DevEx): Accessibility nits: helper text under the IP/CIDR inputs needs aria-describedby and the test button needs aria-live updates for status changes. Warning icon contrast is low against the yellow background — current hex fails 4.5:1. Suggest using a stronger color. Also keyboard flow: when you skip a step the focus should move to the next step header.
Ana (Product): Copy tweak: change helper "CIDR" blurb to: "CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16) — ranges used for VPC routing. Enter multiple ranges separated by commas." Keep it short and action-oriented. Also add a tiny "why we ask" link that opens docs in a side panel.
Michael (Design): UX question: do we show specific ports (22, 443, 53) or a generic "open these ports" callout? Real customers get confused when we list ports without explaining which direction/protocol. My vote: show a compact two-column table -> port | why it's needed.
Srini (Eng): Table is fine. For test commands we should offer both curl and nc examples. Example for health check:
```
# run from customer network
curl -sS -D - https://private.redwood.example/health || echo "failed"
# or quick TCP check
nc -vz private.redwood.example 443
```
Make sure these live in a copyable inline block.
Jia (DevEx): Docs anchors: add anchors for each step and deep links from the warning details. Also include an example terraform snippet in the docs for the common VPC shapes we see.
Ana (Product): Also adding a "Skip and validate later" flow — but product constraint: users must re-run preflight before finalizing a private deployment. Suggested microcopy for the skip CTA: "Skip and validate later — preflight required before creating a private deployment." Thoughts?
Michael (Design): That microcopy reads fine. For accessibility, make sure the skip is a secondary action (not same visual weight as primary). Add keyboard-only confirmation if they skip all network checks.
Srini (Eng): I'll add an API flag to surface conditional fields (publicAccess: boolean) and return a preflightId so the UI can poll. ETA: Monday for a backend branch.
ci-bot: preview-deploy: Preview for this Figma/PR is up at https://staging.redwood.io/preview/wizard/1859987654 — runs nightly.
Ana (Product): Thanks all — I'll update the Figma with the new labels, inline test blocks, and the a11y notes and then ping again. Tagging @Jia to help with docs anchors. :pray:
